ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen to the snakes if the hawk population increased?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. The hawk is located at the upper left, and the snake is located in the middle left. There is an arrow in the figure pointing from the snake to the hawk, indicating that the hawk feeds on the snake or obtains energy from the snake. Reasoning: The question asks if the number of hawks increases, what will happen to the snake. The hawk is the predator of the snake; an increase in the number of hawks will prey on more snakes, therefore the number of snakes will decrease.
